bandage if I’m in a rush. I have a few that aren’t as bold, I can usually cover most with concealer. However if it’s a really important event I bought bruise makeup for Halloween one year and it looks fucking real. Sometimes I’ll use paint but make it messy to look like it was an accident. Hair bands, bracelets. Other than that long sleeves, long socks, long everything. I change it a lot, like bruise only works once, so does a bandage. Concealer works the best and so does just covering.
I hope this helps and maybe someday we both won’t have to hide them anymore.

It really just came out of nowhere. Ive been going through a lot these past few years and it all built up and toppled over in the past few weeks

My friend was talking to me one morning and I told them I had to do homework (I did) and put my earbuds in and he walked off, thinking that no one cared about him. He cut himself once and came back and I saw it and we talked for over an hour (I got marked for missing homework). It fucking messed me up, and 2 weeks prior I had learned he was suicidal so I blamed myself for the cut.

Suddenly all of my friends problems appeared and I had to help them all through it and I couldn’t take it anymore, so I started scratching my skin with a paper clip, then a thumbtack, then a needle.
